items.text: In continuation of our letter of today's date on the Unaudited Financial Results (Consolidated and Standalone) for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, we attach a copy of media release being issued by the Company.

In continuation of our letter dated October 27, 2026, we wish to inform you that the Board of Directors of the Company, at its meeting held today, has, inter alia:1. approved the unaudited Financial Results (Consolidated and Standalone) for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026; and2. passed an enabling resolution authorising the issuance of listed, secured / unsecured, redeemable non-convertible debentures up to Rs. 15,000 crore, in one or more tranches, on private placement basis.

The turnover of HFL for the calendar year 2025 was Rs. 56.08 crore and its contribution to the consolidated turnover of the Company for the financial year 2025-26 was 0.0048%. It had Nil networth as on December 31, 2025. The above intimation was received by the Company on October 28, 2026 at 3:11 p.m. (IST). This is for information and records. items.text: Trading in equity shares of Jio Platforms Limited (JPL) will commence from October 28, 2026.Further, a meeting of board of directors of JPL is scheduled to be held on Friday, October 30, 2026, inter alia, to consider and approve the standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results of JPL for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.

The meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on October 30, 2026, inter alia, to consider and approve a. the standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026; and b. raising of funds by way of issuance of listed, secured / unsecured, redeemable non-convertible debentures on private placement basis, in one or more tranches. The Company will hold an analyst meet, post the Board Meeting, to discuss the financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
